objective: Predict measured leave-one-out SV genotyping accuracy using frozen graph/sequence representations

materials.role: released panel and filtered cohort genotypes
materials.finding: Release listing contains panel/decomposed VCFs and a filtered 34G cohort VCF, not variant-level leave-one-out outcomes. No large VCF downloaded.

Bounded 131072-byte HTTP ranges returned 206. bi_all_filters has score_SVR/confidence_level; summary_bi_all has self-genotyping correctness and confusion counts. Neither inspected header contains leave-one-out accuracy.

leave-one-out.smk removes sample from panel, prepares assembly truth, excludes untypable variants, and emits concordance summaries. Implementation is public; per-variant result files were not located in inspected releases.

evidence.statement: HPRC README calls the correctness fields self-genotyping accuracies across panel samples
Self-genotyping and SVR confidence cannot be substituted for unseen-sample leave-one-out accuracy.

supportable_tasks: A separately labelled in-panel self-genotyping robustness task may be feasible after complete provenance/coverage review; it would not answer the requested leave-one-out endpoint.
missing: Per-variant sample-excluded truth versus predicted genotype outcomes and callable/typable denominator
Validated CHM13-to-GRCh38 correspondence if using HGSVC3 labels
open_questions: Whether public working archives contain the per-variant leave-one-out outcomes, rather than only aggregate plots.
justified_handoff: Continue targeted source discovery; do not generate surrogate performance labels or start full genotypability training from FILTER/SVR fields.
